Identity ControlCurrent Standard
StatusActive visual identity standard
PurposeProtect UNYRA's premium, minimalist, corporate, and globally credible visual identity across documents, dashboards, previews, signatures, covers, icons, and future export surfaces.
Source ruleUse the approved palette, approved asset inventory, approved composition priority, premium document standard, and exported visual standard before changing any visual treatment.
Decision rulePrefer restrained approved compositions, spacing, typography, and navy/gold hierarchy over decorative redesign or improvised brand marks.
Asset protectionDo not redraw, stretch, recolor, restyle, replace, or reinterpret approved logos, seals, signatures, imagery, or lockups unless a new approval is explicitly given.

Approved DirectionLink

UNYRA's visual identity is premium, minimalist, corporate, and globally credible.

DirectionRequired signal
PremiumThe identity should feel refined, intentional, and suitable for high-trust business communication.
MinimalistThe system should rely on proportion, spacing, and restraint instead of decoration.
CorporateThe visual language should support procurement, compliance, finance, and executive review.
Globally credibleThe identity should feel appropriate for international trade, cross-border logistics, and institutional counterparties.

It should feel suitable for international trade, procurement, compliance, and executive communication.

Core PaletteLink

Color roleValuePrimary use
Primary navy#08121ETitles, structure, authority, and high-confidence document framing.
Support navy#102436Secondary framing, deep panels, and controlled contrast.
Gold accent#C2A071Premium accents, highlights, rules, and executive emphasis.
Strong gold accent#9D7646Darker accent text or restrained luxury detail.
Ivory#F7F3ECSoft premium surfaces and warm document backgrounds.
Canvas#F3EEE6Neutral page canvas and quiet contrast fields.
Muted support#5B6672Supporting metadata, secondary copy, and low-emphasis labels.
Muted dark#2A3742Body text, table detail, and secondary authority.

Style RulesLink

Style ruleRequired behavior
Dark navy authorityUse dark navy for titles, structure, and authority.
Restrained goldUse gold sparingly for emphasis, accents, and executive polish.
Neutral backgroundsKeep backgrounds neutral and clean.
Spacing and typographyMaintain generous spacing and restrained typography.
Avoid visual noiseAvoid loud color combinations, excessive gradients, and clutter.

Internal Document GuidanceLink

GuidanceRequired behavior
MastheadsKeep mastheads small and elegant.
